name: limine
description: Modern, portable, multiprotocol BIOS/UEFI bootloader and boot manager, used as an alternative to GRUB.
build: cd limine-12.8.0 && CC_FOR_TARGET=cc LD_FOR_TARGET=ld OBJCOPY_FOR_TARGET=objcopy OBJDUMP_FOR_TARGET=objdump READELF_FOR_TARGET=readelf ./configure --prefix="$PREFIX" --enable-bios --enable-bios-cd --enable-uefi-cd --enable-bios-pxe --enable-uefi-ia32 --enable-uefi-x86-64 --docdir="$PREFIX/share/doc/limine-12.8.0"
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
